name: Frank Brasco
bio: a Representative from New York; born in Brooklyn, Kings County, N.Y., October 15, 1932; graduated from St. Michael's High School; B.A., Brooklyn College, Brooklyn, N.Y., 1955; L.L.B., Brooklyn Law School, Brooklyn, N.Y., 1957; United States Army Reserve; attorney; assistant district attorney, Kings County; elected as a Democrat to the Ninetieth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 1967-January 3, 1975); was not a candidate for reelection to the Ninety-fourth Congress in 1974; died on October 19, 1998; interment at Cemetery of the Holy Rood, Westbury, N.Y.
